Hi Sophie — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps below. I'm including Laura (Solutions) and Connor (Customer Success) to keep continuity on the technical and CS side.

What we heard from Caravel:
- Goal: real-time personalization for web + mobile (sub-100ms p99 tail target)
- Traffic: pilot ~50 qps, prod goal 500-1k qps within 6 months
- Data constraints: EU-only customer set for Region X; some PII encrypted and needs KMS/HSM
- Key success metrics: p99 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and observability/traceability for model rollouts

Redwood recommended approach:
- Start with Dedicated pool for predictable latency and KV cache enabled
- Run first 90-day pilot on a smaller instance class with autoscaling policy to hit 50–200 qps
- Use prefix caching and batching suggestions from Redwood Optimize to improve unit economics

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-caravel.pdf (draft MAP), inference-demo-recording.mp4 (demo recording)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3MUTUALPLAN

Proposed next steps:
1) Review MAP and comment by EOD 3/3
2) Redwood to deliver an MVP pricing estimate and footprint by 3/5 (attached mock spreadsheet: mvp-pricing.xlsx)
3) Schedule a 1-hr technical deep dive with your infra team (Connor to propose times)

Let me know if you'd like me to expand any section of the MAP. If the timeline needs to shift, tell us the target month and we'll adapt the pilot sizing.

Thanks,
